title: Miami: The Gateway
description: Start where Monumental starts. Everything set in Miami-Dade County, from the City of Miami and its neighbourhoods to the separate City of Miami Beach, gathered here automatically as new stories arrive.

title: Free to Watch
description: Everything you can press play on right now, no membership needed.

title: The WAVEMAKERS Route
description: Puerto Rico, New York, London: everything in the catalogue set along the journey of the opening WAVEMAKERS chapter.

title: Open Archive
description: Public-domain films from libraries and archives, from a 1905 subway ride under Manhattan to Apollo 11's launch, each credited with its source and shown for what it is.

title: Open Cinema
description: Open movies released under Creative Commons licences, credited exactly as their makers ask.

title: Studio Specimens
description: Motion concepts from Monumental's studio: reels and teasers that show how the platform looks, sounds and moves. Illustrative design work, not programme footage.

title: Before 1950
description: Stories set in the first half of the twentieth century, matched by when they take place, not when they were made.

title: Monumental Originals
description: Original programming from Monumental Streams, starting with WAVEMAKERS, and the motion teasers made for it. Original episodes will appear here as they are published.
